blocks.text:
Intrusion into Cloud One platform could jeopardize security of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data

Hackers are reported to have breached the US Air Force’s flagship cloud computing platform, a break-in that comes days after reports that a CIA database was accessed.

Reuters reported Friday that the intrusion into the USAF’s Cloud One platform could jeopardize the security of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
